description.content:
Mockaroo provides a REST API for generating realistic mock data on demand using over 150 built-in field types. The API supports schema-based and field-spec-based generation, multiple output formats (JSON, CSV, TXT, custom-delimited, SQL, XML), background jobs for large requests, and management of named datasets used as lookup sources during generation.
